'''R3-G6''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], R3-G6 assisted [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on her mission to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. It later died on this mission.
